visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a Japanese supermarket shelf filled with tea and juice products. It transitions to five different packaged drink products arranged on a white table in a brightly lit indoor studio environment. (2) A person's hands open an orange Nittoh Tea packet. They place a white tea bag into a modern, frosted glass cup with a brown pattern. Clear hot water is poured from a white kettle into the cup, causing steam to rise. (3) Hands use scissors to snip open a purple Nittoh Tea packet. The tea bag is placed in a clear glass featuring star and planet illustrations. A wooden spoon is used to stir the milky light-brown liquid as more hot water is poured in. (4) A yellow Van Houten cocoa box is opened, and a single stick sachet is extracted. The brown powder is poured into a clear glass resting on a circular woven coaster. The kettle pours water, and the person stirs the dark cocoa mixture. (5) A pink resealable bag of Ogawa Seiyaku Rooibos tea is presented. A triangular tea bag is dropped into a clear glass. Hot water is added, quickly turning into a dark, translucent amber liquid as the hands hold the bag for the camera. (6) A purple and green Kokutaigyo Sweet Potato Tea bag is shown. The tea bag is placed in a clear glass. After pouring water and stirring, the person uses a wooden spoon to lift the tea bag, showing visible purple and yellow sweet potato chunks inside. (7) All five products are displayed together on the table. The person holds the orange caramel milk tea package in front of the lens. The background is a clean white studio with a potted plant visible in the corner.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 冬天去日本買什麼. [Variety]: 日本超市 哪款沖泡熱飲 最值得買?! 5款評比一次看. (2) [Slogan]: 日東紅茶 焦糖奶茶. [Subtitle]: 它的焦糖味超級細香 打開包裝就聞得到了 甜度不會太高 我覺得還不錯 不過奶味沒有到非常濃喔. (3) [Slogan]: 日東紅茶 伯爵奶茶 (無糖). [Subtitle]: 我本來就很喜歡 日東的伯爵茶 所以對這款伯爵奶茶 期待還蠻高的 它跟剛剛的焦糖奶茶是同系列 不是奶味重的類型 感覺直接買伯爵茶茶包就好 想喝奶茶再自己加鮮奶. (4) [Slogan]: VAN HOUTEN COCOA 牛奶可可. [Subtitle]: 冬天就是熱可可的季節啊 這款可可裡面含有牛奶了 可可味道濃郁 天冷來一杯好幸福 喜歡喝重奶味的話 推薦直接用熱牛奶取代熱水. (5) [Logo]: 小川生藥. [Slogan]: 粉紅南非國寶茶. [Subtitle]: 這款國寶茶有加入GABA 據說能幫助睡眠改善 效果見仁見智 喝起來還蠻清爽的. (6) [Logo]: 國太樓. [Slogan]: 鳴門金時地瓜茶. [Subtitle]: 它聞起來就是 烤地瓜的香味! 使用鳴門金時地瓜製作 香味雖然是地瓜香 但喝起來是一般的茶飲 超級特別 茶包裡面 有切成一塊塊的地瓜粒. (7) [Subtitle]: 5款中 我最喜歡. [Slogan]: 焦糖奶茶. [Variety]: 這些在日本超市 都找得到喔! 想買的先手刀收藏起來.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat Japanese pop music begins with a bright acoustic guitar strumming pattern and a male vocal melody. The sound of plastic packaging rustling is audible as the video transitions to the product line-up. (2) A bouncy 'pop' bubble sound effect marks the shift to the first product review. This is followed by the continuous, rhythmic glugging sound of hot water being poured into a glass. (3) Another 'pop' transition sound effect occurs. The metallic clinking of a spoon against glass provides a high-frequency rhythmic layer over the BGM as the tea is stirred. (4) A crisp mechanical click and paper rustling sound are heard as the cocoa box is opened. The sound of powder being poured is faint but present, followed by the louder sound of water hitting the glass. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound effect transitions to the next item. Packaging rustling is prominent as the resealable bag is handled. The music reaches a high-energy chorus with synthesizers and heavy drum kicks. (6) A 'pop' sound signals the final review. The metallic clinking and water splashing sounds repeat with high clarity. The BGM maintains a consistent high arousal and positive valence throughout. (7) Final transition 'pop' sound effect is heard as the video concludes. The music continues with a full instrumental outro before a clean cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Sequence of 5 Items -> Final Recommendation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a consumer guide for tourists or locals shopping at Japanese supermarkets during winter. By providing a comparative review of five specific instant hot beverages, it highlights the unique qualities of each (flavor, ingredients, mood) and offers a subjective recommendation to help viewers make informed purchasing decisions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of specific brand names, package designs, and positive experiential commentary ('good smell', 'happy feeling').

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-arousal J-pop music and fast-paced editing to create an engaging 'vibe' typical of social media shopping guides.
